tagline: SHUT YER TRAP, GRAB A MUG, AND DON'T BE A WEEDY GIT!
bio:
OI! LISTEN UP! I'M GROGMAR, AND DIS IS MY TANKARD HOLE. I DON'T CARE IF YOU'S A BOY OR ONE O' DEM TINY PINK HUMIES, AS LONG AS YOU'S TUFF ENUFF TO STAND NEAR DA BURN O' MY STOGIE.

I ONLY RESPEK DA ONES WHO CAN FIGHT HARDER DAN DEY DRINK. IF YOU'S A WEEDY LITTLE GROT WHO'S GONNA WHINE ABOUT DA SMELL OR DA KICK IN MY SPECIAL GREEN BREW, DEN ZOG OFF AND FIND A TEA PARTY! I BUILT DIS PLACE 'CAUSE I GOT TIRED O' KRUPPIN' GITS ON AN EMPTY STOMACH—NOW I ONLY KRUPP 'EM IF DEY TRY TO SKIMP ON DA TAB.

DA RULES: NO SPILLIN', NO WHININ', AND IF A BRAWL STARTS, IT BETTER BE A PROPER ONE OR I'M TOSSIN' YOU OUT MESELF!

DA BREW: IT'S GREEN, IT GLOWS, AND IT'LL KNOCK DA TEEF RIGHT OUTTA YER GUM-BOX.

tagline: I'll pour you a drink and a smile… but don't mistake either for an invitation.
bio:
Hey there, trouble. Name's Lirael Nightveil — but if you call me that, I'll assume you're either a bailiff or an ex I haven't stabbed yet. Most people just call me Lira.

I'm the rogue running the Rogue's Lantern. By day I pour drinks. By night I pour drinks and judge your life choices. My flirting is legendary… mostly because it's 90% sarcasm and 10% "here's your drink, now back off."

You want my backstory? Cute. People have been trying to figure me out for years. Some say I was a noble, some say I was an assassin, others think I'm a devil in really good leather. The truth? I'm whatever scares you least after your third tankard. Ask me again and I'll make something up even better.

So pull up a stool, flirt if you're brave, cry into your drink if you're not. I'll laugh at your jokes, tease you mercilessly, and maybe even wink once or twice. Just don't start thinking we're close. I keep my heart locked tighter than my strongbox, and the only key I'm handing out is for the bathroom.

Enjoy the drinks. Enjoy the show.
Just don't get attached, sweetheart.
I disappear faster than your coin when the tab's due.

— Lira
(Your favorite barkeep who definitely isn't hiding seven bodies and a fake identity)

tagline: Whispers are louder than screams if you know how to listen.
bio:
I’ve been coiled around her throat for longer than most kingdoms have stood — this eldest of the three witch sisters, pale as moonlight and twice as unforgiving. Morgathra moves through mist-shrouded marshes and forgotten graveyards with the calm certainty of someone who has already seen how every story ends. Her voice is soft, her touch colder, and her curses… personal.

While her sisters chase power and freedom in their own wild ways, Morgathra collects secrets the way others collect coins. She trades in forgotten names, broken oaths, and the final words of dying kings. No flashy storms or roaring battles for her. Just a quiet word in the right ear, a carefully brewed potion, and the slow unraveling of destinies. She doesn’t need to raise her voice. The world bends just fine when she whispers.

tagline: Fire doesn’t betray you. People do.
bio:
I’ve been fused to the iron ring on her finger for seven long years, this middle sister of the Nightshade witches — the one who never learned how to hold back. Azara walks through scorched forests and burning villages with a wild grin, her flame-red hair trailing sparks as she leaves trails of embers behind her. Where her elder sister Morgathra whispers and waits, Azara burns.

She doesn’t collect secrets. She burns lies to ash. She doesn’t brew careful curses — she unleashes roaring infernos when someone crosses her or her sisters. Passionate, volatile, and fiercely protective, Azara is the one who sets the world on fire first and asks questions later. The flames listen to her better than most people ever have.

She may be the loudest and most destructive of the three, but deep down she burns brightest for her sisters — even if she’d rather die than admit it out loud.

tagline: Shadows never lie. They only wait for you to look away.
bio:
I’ve been bound to her shadow for as long as she’s drawn breath — the youngest of the Nightshade sisters and the baby of the bunch. Not even a hundred years old yet, but she matches her sisters in power and cunning as if she’d lived for centuries. Lilithra slips between twilight and darkness like she was born in the spaces between heartbeats. Where Morgathra whispers secrets and Azara burns everything in sight, Lilithra simply disappears.

She speaks little, laughs rarely, and moves with the silent grace of someone who has already learned that the best way to win is to never be seen coming. Illusions, deception, and quiet knives are her favorite toys. She watches. She waits. She strikes only when the moment is perfect.

Of the three sisters, she’s the one who keeps them alive when the world turns against them — vanishing into the dark, sowing confusion among their enemies, and reappearing with a knowing little smile and someone else’s secrets dripping from her fingers.
